newsitem.title: USA: US Industries sells off Ground Round stake.
newsitem.headline: US Industries sells off Ground Round stake.

text.p: US Industries Inc said Thursday it sold its remaining 27.7 percent stake in Ground Round Restaurants Inc for about $6 million to a partnership led by two US Industries executives.
The shares were sold in a cash transaction at Wednesday's closing price of 1-5/16 per share, it said.

The company said the stake was bought by Christian Guntner and David DiPasquale, who are leaving USI to pursue this opportunity. Guntner had been Senior Vice President - Corporate Development and DiPasquale has been a group executive.
U.S. Industries said it had recorded the equity holdings of Ground Round as a discontinued operation in June 1996 and therefore there will be no gain or loss recorded as a result of this transaction.
"This sale completes our previously announced decision to sell our shares in Ground Round Restaurants," US Industries chairman and chief executive officer David Clarke said in a statement.
